_about: Banks for dungeon/life/grooming.py `age_signs`: what getting older adds to a companion's looks at seeded ages (Everyone gets older, v0.14). grey: added to their hair; lines: their face; reading: reading glasses (`modern`: only in a modern or future city). `stage` 1 is the first sign, 2 some years on, 3 many years on. Each text is said after "with" and names no pronoun, so it fits a picture and their own prompt.
